caseName: Kansas City Motion Picture Machine Operators, Local No. 170 v. Hughes
caseNameFull: Kansas City Motion Picture Machine Operators, Local No. 170 v. John E. Hughes, etc.

opinions.text: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Missouri. October 11, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari herein denied. Mr. William J. Hughes and Mr. Joseph W.
